name: Yamanashi

flag.description: A white Mount Fuji outline on a magenta field, enclosing three orange 人 (people) joined into the character 山 (yama).
flag.symbolism: Three 人 joined into 山 stand for the people working together; the white Fuji stands for purity, and the purple is the color of Yamanashi's grapes.

hook: Yamanashi puts Mount Fuji on grape purple, with three little orange people inside forming 山 (yama, "mountain").
trivia: Mount Fuji stands on the border of Yamanashi and Shizuoka.
Yamanashi grows more grapes and peaches than any other prefecture.
